technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term bullish structure (three white soldiers, supertrend, OBV) conflicting with intermediate bearish technicals (below 50/200 MAs, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud); weak trend strength (ADX 13.64) limits conviction.

fundamental.summary: TSCO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 22 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite weak congressional selling pressure and absent news confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (321), strong dollar pressures discretionary consumer stocks, and earnings event in 22 days compounds volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + supertrend bullish + OBV accumulation + extreme fear sentiment (16/100) create a contrarian reversal setup near support (35.07), with short-term momentum favoring entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below both 50/200 MAs, MACD negative, ADX weak (13.64), macro environment in crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 321, strong dollar), earnings risk in 22 days, and zero fundamental conviction make this a high-risk fade of a weak bounce.

decision.entry_rationale: While three white soldiers and supertrend offer short-term bullish structure with extreme fear sentiment creating contrarian appeal, the setup is undermined by price trapped below 50/200 MAs, negative MACD, weak ADX trend confirmation, and zero fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 22 days combined with macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 321, strong dollar) creates uncompensated volatility risk that outweighs short-term technical bounce potential.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 16 positions in Consumer Discretionary sector; adding TSCO increases concentration risk in a macro headwind environment without offsetting fundamental or institutional support.
